claim: Story S2.2 is implemented and verified in CI: front-end shell with Uzbek and Russian message catalogs, role-aware navigation, hash router, Telegram Mini App helper and a bundle budget check. 203 front-end tests passed; the staff entry point is 72.85 KB gzip against a 300 KB budget (NFR-010). The orchestrator re-ran lint, type check, tests and the budget script on the helper's branch before merging. Load time on a 3G connection was not measured.
